text:
Mira: heads-up, new model intake: nebula-7b (ggml-ish) landed in the model catalog. I'm proposing we prioritize a quick perf + quantization sweep this week.
Jay: +1. what's the target SLO?
Mira: target P95 latency < 220ms for 1-2 token streaming at 4k ctx on dedicated A100 pool. throughput target 80 reqs/s for batch=8 (32k tokens/day trial).
Sam: noted. do we have a reference baseline (current llama-7b int8 or phoenix7b) to compare?
Mira: baseline: phoenix7b int8 on the same pool — P95 ~200ms for 1-2 tokens, batch=8 throughput 92 reqs/s. we expect nebula-7b quant int8 to be similar-ish.
Tara: plan: 1) microbench latency single-thread 1-2 toks 2) batch sweep [1,2,4,8,16] 3) ctx sweep [4k,8k,16k,32k] 4) int8 vs int4 quant perf + quality smoke.
Mira: add KV-cache pressure test and token-gen tail latency (50k sample with warm cache).
Jay: I'll scope the scripts. Sam want to own quality regressions (perplexity + 50-shot eval subset)?
Sam: can do. for quant QCs: run rouge/bertscore on 500 prompt set and regression alerts if >3% drop vs baseline.
perf-bot: scheduled job created: bench/nebula7b/quick-sweep @ 2026-03-20T15:30Z (run id: nb7b-20260320-01) :white_check_mark:
Mira: good. prioritize int4/4bit-llm and int8-ffn variations. include generation token rejection checks (hallucination smoke).
Jay: quick config I plan to run: ```
MODEL=nebula-7b
QUANTS=(int8 int4)
BATCHES=(1 2 4 8 16)
CTX=(4096 8192 16384 32768)
RUNS=200
```
Jay: will route to dedicated-a100-west by default, fallback to shared-hosted if saturated.
Tara: add perf counters: GPU util, mem, nvlink, kernel-time breakdown. put logs into s3://redwood-perf/nebula7b/sweeps/nb7b-20260320-01/
Mira: priority = P1 for initial perf numbers (we need to decide whether to onboard to dedicated catalog). if we hit >15% throughput regression vs baseline, we flag for deeper kernel/kernel-tuning work.
Sam: planning quality smoke in parallel. will post PR with prompt set and evaluation notebook. expected ETA 6h after perf-run completes.
Jay: kicked off the quick-sweep now. tailing logs: ```
[2026-03-20T15:30:12Z] nb7b-01 batch=1 ctx=4096 quant=int8 p95=198ms thrpt=95 rps
[2026-03-20T15:31:05Z] nb7b-01 batch=8 ctx=4096 quant=int8 p95=210ms thrpt=90 rps
[2026-03-20T15:33:40Z] nb7b-01 batch=8 ctx=16384 quant=int8 p95=330ms thrpt=42 rps (KV pressure)
```
Mira: looks like ctx=16k is where latency rises — expected. keep going, want full matrix.
perf-bot: sweep update: 6/48 jobs failed due to OOM on int4+16k, auto-retry queued.
Tara: for OOMs capture smaps + allocator stats, and run a smaller parallelism variant. also note any kernel-fallback logs.
Sam: spotted small quality drop for int4 on abstractive summarization (bert-score -2.8%). saving examples to /tmp/nebula_int4_qc/ for triage.
Mira: decision rubric reminder: if int4 throughput >= 0.9*int8 && quality delta < 3% -> recommend int4; else keep int8. also consider memory footprint saving for dedicated capacity.
Jay: will collect perf matrix + cost calc (GPU hours estimate + per-token cost delta) and post results in this thread when done. ETA ~2.5h.
Mira: thanks. tagging @Tara for infra follow-up if we need kernel patches. :pray:
Tara: ack. I'll watch OOM re-runs and escalate to eng-runtime if we hit consistent allocator failures.
Mira: perfect. keeping this P1 for the day. we'll decide onboarding next biz day based on combined perf+quality. :rocket:
